    ("192.168.1.1 2023-01-15 2023-02-20 error", ["2023-02-20"]),
    # Line without IP - should not match
    ("2023-01-15 error", []),

    ("192.168.1.1 error", []),

    ("192.168.1.1 2023-01-15 2023-02-20 2023-03-10", ["2023-03-10"]),
    # Date with invalid month - should not match
    ("192.168.1.1 2023-13-15", []),
    # Date with invalid day - should not match
    ("192.168.1.1 2023-02-30", []),
    # Valid Feb 29 - should match
    ("192.168.1.1 2023-02-29", ["2023-02-29"]),
    # Invalid IP (leading zeros) - should not match the IP, so no date match
    ("192.168.001.1 2023-01-15", []),
]

print("Testing regex pattern:")
for test_input, expected in test_cases:
    matches = re.findall(pattern, test_input, re.MULTILINE)
    status = "✓" if matches == expected else "✗"
    print(f"{status} Input: {test_input!r}")
    print(f"  Expected: {expected}, Got: {matches}")
    if matches != expected:
        print(f"  MISMATCH!")
    print()
EOF
